name: com.mycore.connectivitykit
description: Knows whether the game server is reachable, not just whether Wi-Fi is on: an HTTP probe that only counts a direct 200 (captive portals read as offline), a watcher with Online/Offline state, shared probes, offline backoff and WaitForOnlineAsync for offline queues.

samples.description: A watcher probing a local Nakama /healthcheck, logging every state change.
